description: Ministry of Megapolis and Urban Development - Order to acquire the land in Maharagama, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District under section 15 (1) of the Urban Development Authority

It contains detailed property descriptions including plan numbers, surveyor information, boundaries, and exact land area measurements. While it mentions a government minister (Patali Champika Ranawaka), this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is the transfer of land ownership rights.
